antĕ-grĕdĭor , gressus, 3, v. dep. -gradior,
I.to go before, to precede (perh. only in Cic.): “stella Veneris cum antegreditur solem,” Cic. N. D. 2, 20, 53 : “quicquid est quod deceat, id tum adparet, cum antegressa est honestas,” id. Off. 1, 27, 94 ; id. Fat. 10; id. Div. 1, 14.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
